about: How heavy work runs, in one place (owner decision A, 28 Nov 2026, project-state#4160): CI runs the journeys; a builder runs only the tests beside its change; a full local stack runs only in a shared slot, queued, to prove a visible change; the beta keeps its own slot. stack-rule.mjs reads this file for every start; beta-host.mjs takes the beta's slot from it; the factory's pull reads it from main to derive how many builders the box holds (the factory hub's machine/load/owners.py, box_ceiling). Change the rule here and nowhere else. stackGiB: one stack's measured peak with its journey browser (anonymous memory, on the box, 21 Nov: the factory hub's #918). queueMinutes: how long a start waits for a shared slot, and on Linux for stackGiB of memory over keepFree, before it says to prove on CI. keepFree: the share of memory the box's memory killer keeps free (earlyoom -m 25, the factory hub's machine/linux/setup.sh).
